name: Gaussian-mixture EM with log-sum-exp
task:
Create /tmp/eval_gmm/gmm.py defining fit_gmm(X, weights, means, covs, max_iter, tol): expectation-maximisation for a K-component Gaussian mixture with full covariance matrices, started from the given parameters. Python standard library only (no numpy, scipy, sklearn, torch, mpmath, sympy, pandas, jax).

INPUTS (plain Python lists/floats): X is a list of n points, each a list of d floats (1 <= d <= 4, n <= 600); weights is a list of K floats > 0 summing to 1 (1 <= K <= 4); means is a list of K lists of d floats; covs is a list of K symmetric positive-definite d x d matrices (lists of lists); max_iter is an int >= 0; tol is a float > 0.

DEFINITIONS. For parameters theta = (w, mu, Sigma): log N(x | mu, Sigma) = -1/2 * ( d*ln(2*pi) + ln det(Sigma) + (x-mu)^T Sigma^-1 (x-mu) ), and L(theta) = sum_i ln( sum_k w_k N(x_i | mu_k, Sigma_k) ) (natural logarithms).
ALGORITHM. theta_0 = the given parameters. For t = 0, 1, 2, ...: compute L_t = L(theta_t) and append it to the trace. Then, if t >= 1 and L_t - L_{t-1} <= tol * n, stop with converged = True. Otherwise, if t == max_iter, stop with converged = False. Otherwise theta_{t+1} is one EM update of theta_t: r_ik = w_k N(x_i|mu_k,Sigma_k) / sum_j w_j N(x_i|mu_j,Sigma_j); N_k = sum_i r_ik; new w_k = N_k / n; new mu_k = sum_i r_ik x_i / N_k; new Sigma_k = sum_i r_ik (x_i - new mu_k)(x_i - new mu_k)^T / N_k. No regularisation, no variance floor, no other stopping rule.

RETURN a dict: "log_likelihood": [L_0, ..., L_T] as floats; "weights", "means", "covs": theta_T, the parameters whose log-likelihood is the LAST trace entry (for max_iter = 0 that is the initial parameters), same nesting as the inputs; "converged": a bool.

GRADING: hidden cases. Every trace entry must be within 1e-9 * max(1, |L|) of the reference, the trace length must match exactly, the trace must be non-decreasing, and weights/means/covs must match to about 1e-6 relative to the data's spread. Hidden inputs include: coordinates of magnitude anywhere from about 1e-150 to 1e150; a common offset of magnitude up to 3e6 relative to clusters of unit spread; initial covariances far narrower than the distance from the data to the initial means (L_0 of order -1e8); and outliers. Every N_k stays well above zero and every Sigma_k stays well-conditioned (condition number below 1e4) in every hidden case, so no degeneracy handling is needed. All hidden cases together must finish within 10 seconds of CPU time (a direct pure-Python implementation needs about 1 s), in one process (no subprocesses). The source is linted: no dynamic imports, exec/eval or import-hook tampering.

A worked sample: /tmp/eval_gmm/sample_input.json holds the keyword arguments of one small case; /tmp/eval_gmm/sample_output.json holds the returned dict for it.

# Validator template for 188_gmm_em. build_task.py splices gen.py and the
# reference (gmm.py) in at the two markers and stores the result as the task's
# validation.script. Hidden cases are generated here, fed over stdin, and a
# failure names only the case index and the kind of mismatch.
import json, math, os, shutil, sys, tempfile
import vlib

SOL = "/tmp/eval_gmm/gmm.py"
if not os.path.isfile(SOL):
    print("FAIL missing /tmp/eval_gmm/gmm.py"); sys.exit(1)
src = open(SOL, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()


BANNED = ("numpy", "scipy", "sklearn", "torch", "jax", "pandas", "mpmath", "sympy")

# AST lint: every import form of a banned package, plus the dynamic escape
# hatches (__import__, importlib, exec/eval, computed getattr, dunder walks).
# Second line of defence only: the solution runs in a separate process that
# holds no answers, under -I -S (no site-packages), with an import blocker.
# The import machinery is banned by name too, so the driver's blocker can't be
# unhooked (sys.meta_path, `from sys import meta_path`, operator.attrgetter).
IMPORT_HOOKS = ("meta_path", "path_hooks", "path_importer_cache", "attrgetter", "methodcaller")
_lint = vlib.lint_python(src, ban_modules=BANNED, ban_calls=IMPORT_HOOKS)
try:
    import ast
    for _n in ast.walk(ast.parse(src)):
        if isinstance(_n, ast.ImportFrom) and any(a.name in IMPORT_HOOKS for a in _n.names):
            _lint.append(f"line {_n.lineno}: import of an import hook")
except SyntaxError:
    pass
if _lint:
    print("FAIL forbidden import or construct (standard library only):", _lint[0][:160]); sys.exit(1)

# ---- hidden generator -------------------------------------------------------
"""Hidden-case generator for 188_gmm_em (embedded verbatim into the task's
validator by build_task.py; never written to the agent-visible dir).

Case families, by index (the validator prints only the index on failure):
  0-2  overlapping clusters, d=1..3          (plain EM correctness)
  3    K=1, max_iter=2                        (one-step MLE; at t=2 the convergence
       test and t == max_iter both hold -> converged=True, convergence first)
  4    max_iter=0                             (trace of length 1, init params)
  5    max_iter=7 cap, tiny tol               (converged=False path)
  6-8  initial covariances far narrower than the data-to-mean distance:
       every per-point density underflows to 0.0 at t=0 (LL0 ~ -1e8)
  9    ~1.6% outliers 40-60 sd out            (some densities underflow)
  10   coordinates ~1e-70, d=3                (det(Sigma) ~1e-420 underflows)
  11   coordinates ~1e70,  d=3                (det(Sigma) ~1e420 overflows)
  12-13 common offset 1e6 / -3e6              (one-pass E[xx^T]-mu mu^T cancels)
  14   d=4, K=3
  15-16 coordinates ~1e-150 / 1e150, d=2 (2x2 det ~1e-600 / 1e600: a closed-
       form adjugate inverse or det breaks even where d=2 survived 1e+-70)
  17   identical initial means and covariances, unequal weights, all far
       narrower than the data-to-mean distance: every density underflows at
       t=0, so r_ik = w_k exactly. An E-step that falls back to a one-hot
       argmax when every density underflows empties a component (N_k = 0).
Robustness (re-checked by build_task.py --check): an independent
correct solution and the reference on reversed point order agree to <=2e-12
relative on every trace, and every stopping decision clears float noise by
>=30x, so no correct implementation can flip an iteration count.
"""
import math, random

def _spd(rng, d, lo=0.4):
    B = [[rng.gauss(0, 1) for _ in range(d)] for _ in range(d)]
    S = [[sum(B[i][k] * B[j][k] for k in range(d)) / d + (lo if i == j else 0.0)
          for j in range(d)] for i in range(d)]
    return S

def _cholL(S, d):
    L = [[0.0] * d for _ in range(d)]
    for j in range(d):
        L[j][j] = math.sqrt(S[j][j] - sum(L[j][k] ** 2 for k in range(j)))
        for i in range(j + 1, d):
            L[i][j] = (S[i][j] - sum(L[i][k] * L[j][k] for k in range(j))) / L[j][j]
    return L

def make(rng, d, K, n, sd=1.0, sep=8.0, off=0.6, isd=1.0, outl=0, mi=80, tol=1e-9):
    """Clusters of spread `sd` with centres `sep*sd` apart; init means displaced
    by `off*sd`, init covariances (isd*sd)^2 * I."""
    cents = []
    while len(cents) < K:
        c = [rng.uniform(-sep, sep) * sd * K ** (1 / d) for _ in range(d)]
        if all(math.dist(c, e) > sep * sd for e in cents):
            cents.append(c)
    X = []
    sizes = [n // K + (1 if k < n % K else 0) for k in range(K)]
    for k in range(K):
        L = _cholL(_spd(rng, d), d)
        for _ in range(sizes[k]):
            g = [rng.gauss(0, 1) for _ in range(d)]
            X.append([cents[k][i] + sd * sum(L[i][j] * g[j] for j in range(i + 1)) for i in range(d)])
    for _ in range(outl):
        b = rng.randrange(n)
        X.append([X[b][i] + rng.choice((-1, 1)) * rng.uniform(40, 60) * sd for i in range(d)])
    rng.shuffle(X)
    means = []
    for k in range(K):
        u = [rng.gauss(0, 1) for _ in range(d)]
        nu = math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in u))
        means.append([cents[k][i] + off * sd * u[i] / nu for i in range(d)])
    covs = [[[(isd * sd) ** 2 if i == j else 0.0 for j in range(d)] for i in range(d)] for _ in range(K)]
    w = [rng.uniform(0.5, 1.5) for _ in range(K)]
    s = sum(w)
    return {"X": X, "weights": [v / s for v in w], "means": means, "covs": covs,
            "max_iter": mi, "tol": tol}

def transform(c, scale=1.0, shift=0.0):
    c["X"] = [[v * scale + shift for v in x] for x in c["X"]]
    c["means"] = [[v * scale + shift for v in m] for m in c["means"]]
    c["covs"] = [[[v * scale * scale for v in r] for r in S] for S in c["covs"]]
    return c

def cases():
    rng = random.Random(0x188E3)
    C = []
    C.append(make(rng, 1, 2, 500, sep=1.6, mi=300, tol=1e-10))                    # 0 benign d1
    C.append(make(rng, 2, 3, 500, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-10))                    # 1 benign d2
    C.append(make(rng, 3, 2, 400, sep=1.8, mi=300, tol=1e-9))                     # 2 benign d3
    C.append(make(rng, 2, 1, 120, mi=2, tol=1e-9))                                # 3 K=1, stops at t=2=max_iter
    C.append(make(rng, 2, 2, 60, mi=0))                                           # 4 max_iter=0
    C.append(make(rng, 2, 3, 200, sep=2.5, mi=7, tol=1e-12))                      # 5 iteration cap
    C.append(make(rng, 2, 3, 500, sd=1e-3, sep=2.5, off=0.8, isd=2e-3, mi=300, tol=1e-10))   # 6 underflow
    C.append(make(rng, 1, 2, 400, sd=1e-3, sep=2.5, off=0.8, isd=1e-3, mi=300, tol=1e-10))   # 7 underflow d1
    C.append(make(rng, 3, 2, 400, sd=5e-3, sep=2.5, off=0.8, isd=3e-3, mi=300, tol=1e-10))   # 8 underflow d3
    C.append(make(rng, 2, 2, 500, sep=2.5, outl=8, mi=300, tol=1e-10))           # 9 outliers
    C.append(transform(make(rng, 3, 2, 400, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-9), scale=1e-70))  # 10 tiny scale
    C.append(transform(make(rng, 3, 2, 400, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-9), scale=1e70))   # 11 huge scale
    C.append(transform(make(rng, 2, 2, 500, sep=1.8, mi=300, tol=1e-8), shift=1e6))    # 12 offset d2
    C.append(transform(make(rng, 1, 3, 500, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-8), shift=-3e6))   # 13 offset d1
    C.append(make(rng, 4, 3, 500, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-10))                    # 14 d4
    C.append(transform(make(rng, 2, 2, 400, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-9), scale=1e-150)) # 15 d2 1e-150
    C.append(transform(make(rng, 2, 3, 400, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-9), scale=1e150))  # 16 d2 1e150
    c = make(rng, 2, 2, 300, sep=2.5, mi=300, tol=1e-8)                          # 17 symmetric start
    d = len(c["X"][0])
    cen = [sum(x[a] for x in c["X"]) / len(c["X"]) for a in range(d)]
    m = [cen[0] + 40.0, cen[1] - 25.0]
    c["means"] = [list(m), list(m)]
    c["covs"] = [[[0.01 if a == b else 0.0 for b in range(d)] for a in range(d)] for _ in range(2)]
    c["weights"] = [0.3, 0.7]
    C.append(c)
    return C

# ---- oracle -----------------------------------------------------------------
"""Reference solution for 188_gmm_em: full-covariance GMM EM, stdlib only.

Numerics that the hidden cases exercise:
  * log-densities via Cholesky (log det = 2*sum(log L_ii)) -- no det() that
    under/overflows at coordinate scales 1e-70 / 1e70;
  * E-step in the log domain with log-sum-exp -- per-point densities that
    underflow to 0.0 for every component;
  * two-pass (centred) covariance -- E[xx^T]-mu mu^T cancels at offset 1e6.
"""
import math

_LOG2PI = math.log(2.0 * math.pi)


def _chol(S, d):
    L = [[0.0] * d for _ in range(d)]
    for j in range(d):
        s = S[j][j] - sum(L[j][k] * L[j][k] for k in range(j))
        if not s > 0.0:
            raise ValueError("covariance not positive definite")
        L[j][j] = math.sqrt(s)
        for i in range(j + 1, d):
            L[i][j] = (S[i][j] - sum(L[i][k] * L[j][k] for k in range(j))) / L[j][j]
    return L


def _estep(X, w, mu, cov):
    n, d, K = len(X), len(X[0]), len(w)
    comps = []
    for k in range(K):
        L = _chol(cov[k], d)
        c = math.log(w[k]) - 0.5 * d * _LOG2PI - sum(math.log(L[j][j]) for j in range(d))
        comps.append((L, c, mu[k]))
    LL = 0.0
    R = []
    for x in X:
        lp = []
        for L, c, m in comps:
            # forward substitution: z = L^{-1}(x - m); maha = |z|^2
            z = [0.0] * d
            q = 0.0
            for i in range(d):
                s = x[i] - m[i]
                Li = L[i]
                for j in range(i):
                    s -= Li[j] * z[j]
                s /= Li[i]
                z[i] = s
                q += s * s
            lp.append(c - 0.5 * q)
        mx = max(lp)
        lse = mx + math.log(sum(math.exp(v - mx) for v in lp))
        LL += lse
        R.append([math.exp(v - lse) for v in lp])
    return LL, R


def _mstep(X, R, K):
    n, d = len(X), len(X[0])
    w, mu, cov = [], [], []
    for k in range(K):
        Nk = sum(r[k] for r in R)
        m = [sum(R[i][k] * X[i][j] for i in range(n)) / Nk for j in range(d)]
        S = [[0.0] * d for _ in range(d)]
        for i in range(n):
            r = R[i][k]
            dx = [X[i][j] - m[j] for j in range(d)]
            for a in range(d):
                ra = r * dx[a]
                Sa = S[a]
                for b in range(a + 1):
                    Sa[b] += ra * dx[b]
        for a in range(d):
            for b in range(a + 1):
                S[a][b] /= Nk
                S[b][a] = S[a][b]
        w.append(Nk / n)
        mu.append(m)
        cov.append(S)
    return w, mu, cov


def fit_gmm(X, weights, means, covs, max_iter, tol):
    w = [float(v) for v in weights]
    mu = [[float(v) for v in m] for m in means]
    cov = [[[float(v) for v in row] for row in S] for S in covs]
    K = len(w)
    trace = []
    converged = False
    t = 0
    while True:
        LL, R = _estep(X, w, mu, cov)
        trace.append(LL)
        if t >= 1 and trace[t] - trace[t - 1] <= tol * len(X):
            converged = True
            break
        if t == max_iter:
            break
        w, mu, cov = _mstep(X, R, K)
        t += 1
    return {"log_likelihood": trace, "weights": w, "means": mu,
            "covs": cov, "converged": converged}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

CASES = cases()
REF = [fit_gmm(**json.loads(json.dumps(c))) for c in CASES]

DRIVER = r'''
import importlib.util, json, sys
real = sys.stdout
sys.stdout = sys.stderr
BANNED = %r
class _Block:
    def find_spec(self, name, path=None, target=None):
        if name.split(".")[0] in BANNED:
            raise ImportError("standard library only")
        return None
_BLOCK = _Block()
sys.meta_path.insert(0, _BLOCK)
for _m in [m for m in sys.modules if m.split(".")[0] in BANNED]:
    del sys.modules[_m]
cases = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("gmm_sol", "/tmp/eval_gmm/gmm.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
out = []
for c in cases:
    try:
        r = mod.fit_gmm(c["X"], c["weights"], c["means"], c["covs"], c["max_iter"], c["tol"])
        out.append({"ok": True,
                    "log_likelihood": [float(v) for v in r["log_likelihood"]],
                    "weights": [float(v) for v in r["weights"]],
                    "means": [[float(v) for v in m] for m in r["means"]],
                    "covs": [[[float(v) for v in row] for row in S] for S in r["covs"]],
                    "converged": r["converged"]})
    except Exception as e:
        out.append({"ok": False, "err": type(e).__name__})
if sys.meta_path[:1] != [_BLOCK] or [m for m in sys.modules if m.split(".")[0] in BANNED]:
    out = [{"ok": False, "err": "ImportError"} for _ in cases]
real.write("@@RESULT@@" + json.dumps(out))
real.flush()
''' % (BANNED,)

# The driver holds no answers (only the hidden INPUTS, which arrive on its
# stdin); it is written to a private dir and run as `python -I -S <file>`, so
# no source sits in an argv. CPU budget 10 s at scale 1 for the whole tree.
_dd = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="gmm_drv_", dir=os.getcwd())
_drv = os.path.join(_dd, "driver.py")
try:
    with open(_drv, "w") as f:
        f.write(DRIVER)
    p = vlib.run_solution(vlib.python_cmd(_drv), input=json.dumps(CASES), cpu_s=10, wall_s=15,
                          cwd="/tmp/eval_gmm")
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(_dd, ignore_errors=True)
if p.verdict in ("cpu", "wall"):
    print("FAIL solution timed out (10 s CPU for all hidden cases):", p.reason); sys.exit(1)
if p.verdict != "ok":
    print("FAIL solution refused:", p.reason); sys.exit(1)
if "@@RESULT@@" not in p.stdout:
    print("FAIL solution crashed before returning results:", (p.stderr.strip().splitlines() or ["?"])[-1][:160])
    sys.exit(1)
try:
    GOT = json.loads(p.stdout.rsplit("@@RESULT@@", 1)[1])
except Exception:
    print("FAIL could not decode solution results"); sys.exit(1)


def close(a, b, tol):
    return isinstance(a, float) and math.isfinite(a) and abs(a - b) <= tol


def check(i, c, r, g):
    if not g.get("ok"):
        return "raised " + g.get("err", "?")
    T, G = r["log_likelihood"], g["log_likelihood"]
    if not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in G):
        return "non-finite log-likelihood"
    if any(G[t] < G[t - 1] - 1e-9 * max(1.0, abs(G[t - 1])) for t in range(1, len(G))):
        return "log-likelihood trace not monotone"
    if len(G) != len(T):
        return "trace length differs"
    if not all(close(x, y, 1e-9 * max(1.0, abs(y))) for x, y in zip(G, T)):
        return "log-likelihood trace mismatch"
    if g["converged"] is not r["converged"]:
        return "converged flag wrong"
    K, d = len(r["weights"]), len(c["X"][0])
    if not (len(g["weights"]) == K and len(g["means"]) == K and len(g["covs"]) == K):
        return "parameters mismatch"
    try:
        ok = True
        for k in range(K):
            S = r["covs"][k]
            sd = [math.sqrt(S[a][a]) for a in range(d)]
            ok &= close(g["weights"][k], r["weights"][k], 1e-7)
            ok &= len(g["means"][k]) == d and all(
                close(g["means"][k][a], r["means"][k][a], 1e-12 * abs(r["means"][k][a]) + 1e-6 * sd[a])
                for a in range(d))
            ok &= len(g["covs"][k]) == d and all(
                len(g["covs"][k][a]) == d and all(
                    close(g["covs"][k][a][b], S[a][b], 1e-6 * sd[a] * sd[b]) for b in range(d))
                for a in range(d))
    except (TypeError, IndexError, KeyError):
        ok = False
    return None if ok else "parameters mismatch"


if not isinstance(GOT, list) or len(GOT) != len(CASES):
    print("FAIL wrong number of results"); sys.exit(1)
bad = []
for i, (c, r, g) in enumerate(zip(CASES, REF, GOT)):
    why = check(i, c, r, g)
    if why:
        bad.append(f"case {i}: {why}")
if bad:
    print(f"FAIL {len(bad)}/{len(CASES)} hidden cases; first: {bad[0]}")
    print("failed: " + "; ".join(bad))
    sys.exit(1)
print(f"OK {len(CASES)}/{len(CASES)} hidden cases")
